local_articles.title: F1 leader Kimi Antonelli wins Italian GP after epic charge from the back
local_articles.snippet: Kimi Antonelli took a big step to becoming the youngest champion in Formula 1 history with a fightback for the ages at his home grand prix on Sunday. Antonelli stormed to victory at the Italian Grand Prix, despite having started 19th on the grid. It took the Mercedes driver fewer than 17 laps to fight his way to the front. {{^htLoading}} {{/htLoading}} The rest of the race was spent tussling with teammate and title rival George Russell for the lead. Antonelli passed him for the final time with three laps remaining, going on to become the first Italian to win at Monza in 60 years. "Oh my God ... It feels like a dream," Antonelli said on team radio after crossing the line. Unbelievable, unbelievable'"I did not expect it," Antonelli said later. "Unbelievable, unbelievable. I am so happy, I could not have imagined to be here today but we managed to pull it off and I am really, really happy."

Resolution Date : 2026-09-21 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the sector's conventional name.

priority_updates.title: Who will be the first person charged in the United Kingdom over alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official public charging announcement from the United Kingdom’s Crown Prosecution Service. Resolution : Identify the first individual formally charged in the United Kingdom in connection with alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, provided the charges are announced by December 31, 2026. Arrests without charges, extradition proceedings, and charges brought outside the United Kingdom do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.

priority_updates.title: Which activist detained in Tunisia's Global Sumud Flotilla fundraising case will suspend his hunger strike between September 12 and September 27, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera identifying which of the four detained activists has suspended his hunger strike. Resolution Conditions : The suspension must have occurred between September 12 and September 27, 2026, inclusive. Appeals to suspend the strike or statements of future intention do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The activist's full name.

priority_updates.title: Which national team will win the England–Spain UEFA Nations League match at Wembley on September 19, 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official match result and contemporaneous reporting of the completed match. Resolution : Resolve to the national team declared the winner at full time in the September 19, 2026 fixture. If the match finishes level, resolve as Draw. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.

local_articles.title: Lamine Yamal and Fermin Lopez star as Barcelona run riot at Valencia
local_articles.snippet: pez scored a goal and created two others as champions Barcelona eased to a 5-0 victory over hosts Valencia in their La Liga clash on Sunday to maintain their perfect start to the new football season. Lamine Yamal (two), Raphinha and Pedri were also on target for the visitors, who controlled the contest from the start and lead the LaLiga table with 12 points from four games, three more than second-placed Real Madrid. priority_updates.title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The defendant's name as publicly reported.
